7003311.name: Chabad of Williamstown
7003311.note: CrownHeights.info, 29 Apr 2026 ('Chabad Opens at America's Top Liberal Arts College'): 'This January, their son Rabbi Mendel and his wife Tzivia Volovik moved to Williamstown to launch a full-time Chabad presence on campus' (Williams College); before that, after October 7th, Jewish students had asked Rabbi Levi and Sara Volovik of Chabad of the Berkshires, 'about an hour's drive away', to bring Jewish infrastructure to the school. COLlive, 4 Mar 2026: the Voloviks 'are establishing the first Chabad Center at Williams College'. Medium: its chabad.org listing went up 8 Sept 2025, four months before the move.

4161814.name: Chabad of Shelton
4161814.note: The Shelton Herald on COLlive, 30 Nov 2018 ('New Shluchim to Connecticut'): 'Rabbi Shneur and Leah Brook (nee Olidort) have founded the Chabad Center of Shelton-Monroe in their Soundview Avenue home'; Rabbi Brook 'moved to the city just less than a month ago'; 'the Shelton, Monroe area had no place for Jews to worship'. Its chabad.org listing went up 18 Oct 2018.

5702437.name: Camp Chomeish of New England
5702437.note: COLlive, 5 Jan 2023 ('Camp Chomeish Announces New Director'): Rabbi Sholom Ber and Mrs. Chaya Stock 'have been on hand for the 25 years from Camps inception'. COLlive, 16 July 2025: Rabbi Stock was 'the founder and director of Camp Chomeish Girls Camp' and a shliach in Connecticut 'for the past 35 years'. Medium: counted back (25 years before 2023); its chabad.org listing only went up 15 Nov 2022.
